memories: Transfers are free for 90 minutes after the first validation.
Ticket ids follow the format TK, followed by the date as two-digit year, month and day, a dash, and a four-digit zero-padded sequence.
Monthly passes renew on the first of the month.
The fine for travelling without a ticket is now 70 euros, halved if paid within 7 days.
Peak hours are 07:00 to 09:30 and 16:30 to 18:30 on weekdays. The end times are not included.
Passengers aged 65 or over get 30% off, but not during peak hours.
Nobody pays more than 8.50 euros in one day.
Ages 6 to 14 pay half fare, rounded up to the next 5 cents.
An unused ticket can be refunded within 15 minutes of purchase, minus a 0.50 euro fee.
The base fare is now 2.10 euros, each zone after the first adds 0.60, and a fare is capped at 5.40.
Night buses have a flat fare of 3 euros.
The sidebar badge flickered during the call.
